title: Refactor Uri System
description: Refactor the entire URI system in semio-repo to use the new hierarchical URI scheme (semiorepo://p/u/semio/b/l/js etc.) instead of the old flat scheme (semiorepo://project/semio etc.). Update both GetArtifactURI and GetArtifactID, all GetURI methods on entity types, and all related tests.
